rows.ARS:
Medium red Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Pays d'Iroise ®
rows.Bloom: Red. None to mild fragrance. 20 to 30 petals. Large, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, cupped-to-flat bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Armed with thorns / prickles, bushy, spreading, upright. Medium, glossy, dark green, dense foliage.

Height: 31" to 43" (80 to 110cm). Width: 20" to 2' (50 to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: No. 053 in the 2004 Monza Competition. (Source: Website Roseto Niso Fumagalli.)
